div.div: The review service also uses the RAG package two ways: as a library for parsing (rag/ on sys.path) and as a command line for loading (subprocess.run([sys.executable, script], cwd=rag_dir), promote.py:437). Every fix to the token check, the error envelope or the embedder must be repeated in each copy, and the tests give no signal when one is missed.
